preparation_config.grouping: Union same-source augmentation filename family, exact image SHA256 and D4 near-copy candidates across BOTH sources including within v1 and within v2; numeric filenames alone never merge across sources
preparation_config.near_copy: Interior80%,63bit pHash Hamming<=4 under8 flip/90degree orientations; RGB32 MAE<=0.03 or gray corr>=0.985 and MAE<=0.12; conservative candidates, not patient identity
preparation_config.canonical: One image per conservative connected component. Prefer v2 over v1, then original valid/test over augmented train, then lexicographic SHA256. No mask averaging/warping or label promotion
preparation_config.reserved_test_policy: Any member in either original test split reserves the entire component; no training/selection/evaluation of its masks during this experiment
preparation_config.rejection_policy: Known rejected or banned-source image makes whole component excluded; video duplicate candidates likewise excluded

split.method: SHA256(seed + sorted component source/family identities), before model metrics; patient independence unverified

preparation_config.video_policy: Sequentially screen ALL raw images against ALL2694 video frames with same D4 near-copy method; preserve frozen29video rows byte-for-byte as separate regression manifest; no video derivatives train
preparation_config.supervision: Source polygons with provisional background0; preserve auxiliary tissue/laser masks separately; fiber2 wins stone1 on overlap; missing labels are never negatives
preparation_config.user_authorization: 允许将v1与v2联合去重、分组后建立新版本训练与开发验证清单，保留原29帧视频验证集，再重新训练同预算基线

training_budget.initialization: Clean ImageNet encoder + random decoder; no surgical checkpoint warmstart
